specs.title: <line>A logbook that</line><it>does the math</it> for you.
specs.lede: Twelve precision tools that turn raw IGC into decisions. Each one is built to the standards pilots use in briefings — not marketing.

parser.title: Drop-in parser
parser.body: We read vendor dialects from Flymaster, Skytraxx, XCTrack, Syride, Alfapilot — every IGC, no exceptions.

thermals.title: Thermal recognition
thermals.body: Multi-signal detection blends vario, turn-rate, wind drift, and entry-exit ramps. No more false positives on ridge beats.

scoring.title: XC scoring, auto
scoring.body: Free distance, out-and-return, FAI triangle. Every flight scored against WPRS rules the moment it lands.

metrics.title: Climb & glide metrics
metrics.body: Vertical speeds, glide ratios, turn dynamics — computed from your track. The numbers that matter, on every flight.

wind.title: Wind reconstruction
wind.body: Post-flight wind profile at every altitude, inferred from your drift circles — no external sensor needed.

progression.title: Progression analytics
progression.body: Track how you grow over seasons, sites, and wings. Distance, airtime, climbs, conditions — slice it however you fly.

takeoffs.title: Takeoff database
takeoffs.body: Coordinates, elevation, orientation, best wind directions, current measurements from nearby stations, cam links. Community-curated.

community.title: Community baseline
community.body: Your thermal strength vs. everyone else who flew that site today. Your glide vs. median for your wing class.

sharing.title: Private link sharing
sharing.body: Each flight gets a secret, unguessable URL — only people you send it to can open it. No account needed to view, no public listing.

showcase.title: Replay the thermal you <it>almost</it> centered.
showcase.body: Scrub a 3D replay with vario audio, wind overlay, and thermal cores highlighted. Drop a marker anywhere — your comment syncs to the timestamp.

leaderboard.title: <line>The leaderboard</line>your club <it>argues about</it>.
leaderboard.lede: Computed from validated IGC only — no self-reported distances. Pilots displayed with their handle of choice.

cta.title: <line>Know your flights,</line><it>not just log them.</it>
cta.body: Free for a lifetime. Unlimited flights. No credit card. Your first IGC in under a minute.
